name: shadcn/ui (stock)
description: Unmodified stock shadcn/ui — base-nova style, neutral base color, Geist font, 60 components installed verbatim from the official registry via `shadcn add --all`.

tokens.notes: Semantic CSS variables in :root (light) and .dark (dark). Radius scale derives from the single --radius base. Values are oklch.

components.notes: One file per component, stock shadcn source. Import alias: @/components/ui/<name>.
